FL-091.label: When a judge fails a swarm, its feedback is saved as new packets and a new swarm is sent out, looping until every judge is satisfied.
FL-091.walk: Let a judge fail a round; new packets appear from the feedback and a fresh swarm runs, and the loop ends only when all judges pass.
FL-091.observed: Run 3: round 1 failed with feedback (no candidate), the feedback became round 2's charge, round 2 passed unanimously and merged. Run 2 looped two rounds and stopped with its reason. (Walked on the harness side; Memory changed only its version.)

FL-094.label: Three phases: deliberation with the agent outlining the spec and recipe with judges and metrics, then auto mode, then adversarial review by the judges that loops to go again.
FL-094.walk: Run a symphony; deliberation in chat, then the unattended run, then a judge review round that can send it round again.
FL-094.observed: Deliberation in chat (charter, walls, signature), the unattended run, then the judges' review, which sent runs 2 and 3 round again; the signed charter re-renders signed and locked (FL-094-run5-signed-locked.png) and filled after a block (captures/FL-094-signed-charter-after-block*.png). (Walked on the harness side; Memory changed only its version.)

FL-098.label: The symphony lifecycle shows its human touchpoints, the human prompt and any interjection or steering, so they can be seen.
FL-098.walk: Steer a symphony mid-run; the human prompt and the steering both show on the run's trace.
FL-098.observed: Run 5: a clarification from the Deck showed on the attempt ('Follow-up: ...') and in the timeline (clarified:round-1-attempt-1); the steered attempt won. The chat shows the run's live state (FL-098-run5-running.png, completed FL-098-run5-completed.png). (Walked on the harness side; Memory changed only its version.)

FL-085.label: The work loop: spec alignment with the user, then the agent loop (optionally several agents in worktrees attempting the same thing), then the judge checks the work against the spec and either calls it done or sends another agent to continue or fix, and the human is only brought back in when the judge says done.
FL-085.walk: Run a symphony; attempts run in worktrees, the judge's verdict against the spec appears, and the card returns to the human only after the judge says done.
FL-085.observed: Run 1 (README 'Named palaces'): signed in chat, two attempts in worktrees, three judges passed attempt 2 unanimously, the result card returned to chat and the commit merged; runs 3 and 4 completed the same way (receipts/runs.json). (Walked on the harness side; Memory changed only its version.)

FL-086.label: Both modes supported: a hands-off default with loops, judges and parallel agents, and a traditional chat mode of agent turn then human turn.
FL-086.walk: Run one piece of work as a plain turn-by-turn chat and another as a symphony; both work.
FL-086.observed: A plain Duet turn in the same harness project (tools, 6 requests) answered what `nocturne palace list` prints, beside four Symphony threads. (Walked on the harness side; Memory changed only its version.)
